# Echelon Fox

> Echelon Fox is a founder-led marketing and growth partner for businesses across industries. We work as your marketing team on a monthly subscription — strategy and execution in weekly sprints, no hiring required.

## About

Echelon Fox is run by founder Abe Quinn. Clients work directly with the person doing the work rather than a rotating account team. Engagements cover website design and build, SEO and content, paid media, social media, brand identity, email and CRM, analytics and conversion work, and AI agents and business automation. Industries served include retail and e-commerce, insurance, beauty, pet and home services, professional services, and B2B.

- [About Echelon Fox](https://echelonfox.com/about): Who we are, how we work, and what an engagement looks like.
- [Contact](https://echelonfox.com/contact): Send a message or book a strategy call.

## Services

- [Website Design & Build](https://echelonfox.com/websites): Flat-rate website design and build with local SEO basics included.
- [SEO & Content Strategy](https://echelonfox.com/services/seo-content): Technical SEO, content, and digital PR that build sustained organic visibility.
- [Paid Media Management](https://echelonfox.com/services/paid-media): Campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, and YouTube, managed against cost per lead or sale.
- [Brand Identity & Creative](https://echelonfox.com/services/brand-identity): Branding, design systems, video, and copywriting.
- [Social Media Management](https://echelonfox.com/services/social-media): Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and X — strategy, content, scheduling, and community.
- [Analytics & Growth Strategy](https://echelonfox.com/services/analytics-growth): GA4 setup, dashboards, conversion rate work, and attribution.
- [Email & CRM Marketing](https://echelonfox.com/services/email-crm): Klaviyo, HubSpot, automations, segmentation, and campaign strategy.
- [AI Agents & Automation](https://echelonfox.com/ai-agents): Lead response, appointment scheduling, CRM workflows, customer follow-up, and internal process automation.

## Industries

- [E-Commerce & Retail](https://echelonfox.com/ecommerce): SEO, paid media, email, and creative built around profitable revenue growth.
- [B2B & SaaS](https://echelonfox.com/saas): Pipeline-focused SEO, paid search, and content built around qualified demos and signups.
- [Local & Service Businesses](https://echelonfox.com/websites): Websites and local search for businesses that serve a geographic market.

## Work, Pricing & Insights

- [Selected Work](https://echelonfox.com/work): Projects across insurance, beauty and e-commerce, and pet services.
- [Pricing](https://echelonfox.com/pricing): Flat monthly plans starting at $1,500/mo. Advertising spend is billed separately by the ad platforms.
- [Insights](https://echelonfox.com/insights): Practical guides on local SEO, AI search, and growth.
